skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students can explain basic macroeconomic relationships.
Students apply advanced macroeconomic theories to assess the impact of events and policy changes on key macroeconomic variables.
Students understand and apply techniques for handling time series data in economics and finance.
Students apply time series analysis techniques to quantify macroeconomic relationships and evaluate the impact of policies or shocks on the economy.
Students apply quantitative analysis techniques to analyze important macroeconomic relationships.

Students develop independent work skills, teamwork, and presentation skills to convey knowledge through writing and discussing real-world macroeconomic research scenarios in Vietnam and around the world.
The course cultivates students' ability to learn independently and conduct research on related macroeconomic issues in practice.
The course enhances students' critical thinking skills regarding macroeconomic issues in Vietnam and around the world.
